a0559fd4d893320290c2405d469df769dd0efe5a.summary: A vendor blog post by Nicholas Tan for LogRhythm, published 2024-02-27, on how government agencies can defend against data exfiltration. It mentions recent attacks by the group R00TK1T on Malaysian entities, including the reported theft of 27TB from LPPKN, and then promotes LogRhythm's detection features and a consultation. It is marketing material rather than a threat report.

a03dfdeb731f93804705babfb36670a901137b1c.summary: Archived report page on Blue Termite, a threat actor the report says is believed to have been responsible for the Japan Pension Service incident. Also known as Emdivi and Cloudy Omega. It targets Japanese entities in the government, manufacturing, finance, space, education, food and medical sectors for espionage. Named tools include the EMDIVI backdoor and an Ichitaro zero-day used in Operation CloudyOmega. Suspected state sponsor is listed as Unknown.
